page.layout: One printed page, with running head centred at the top and page number at top right. Below the running head is one block of text in continuous paragraphs, with three short numbered paragraphs (LXXXIII., LXXXIIII.) set as separate lines. No marginal notes or footnotes.

main_text.p: possunt: sed quemadmodum in fabulis Ethni-corum celebrata hydria, sublatis prioribus ser-pentibus, aliisq; pullulantibus, pervicaciter contendebat novo semper obiectu anguium contra eum qui ipsi suos serpentes tollebat: ita quoq; ifti homines animo Ethnico, deiecti ab aliis quae obiiciebāt, alias reperiunt stultas[?] controversias, & quasi veritatem hostem haberet, comminiscuntur nova, ut ita se magis Christi perduelles & oppugnatores declarent: quip-pe qui post tot refutationes, quibus vel Diabo-lus ipse reiectus confususq; retro abiisset, rur-sum ex perverso corde nova alia comminiscun-tur, & his quidem admurmurant, istis verò in-sufurrant, alios rursum veluti culices bombo circumstrepunt. Ibidem.
Quemadmodum sepiæ atramentum, ita simplicioribus tenebras[?] offundunt, ipsi interim sui dogmatis nequaquam obliti. Ibidem.

Si bené fidant suæ sectæ, verbisq; quæ loquuntur, nudam nobis suam hærelin[?] profe-rant, ostendantq;, si quid pro ea defendenda, vel ex sacris litteris, vel ex aliqua humana saltē ratione, quæ quidem pia sit, deducere possint, aut si non possint taceat. Nusquam enim quicquam inventuri sunt, nisi quod faciat ad graviorem ipsorum refutationem, saltem ex Scripturis sacris. Epistola contra Arian. de sententia Dionysii Episcopi Alexandrini.

page.notes: Doubtful readings: "stultas" (the word is partly joined and reads like "sultas"; the st ligature is uncertain); "tenebras" (the word break and letters are hard to make out); "hærelin" (the last letters are unclear, possibly "hæresin"). Abbreviations kept as printed: "q;", "obiiciebāt" with macron, "saltē" with tilde. Long s has been written as plain s throughout. Printed accents "bené", "verò" kept as printed. Hyphens at line ends kept as printed.
